'''BioTech Industries''' was one of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] major [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] technology and medical corporations. The company was owned jointly by the [[Neuro-Saav Corporation]] and the [[Tagge Company/Legends|Tagge Company]].<ref name="EGWT" /> [[ConCare]] was a subsidiary of the company.

Among BioTech's products were the [[Borg Construct Aj^6]], and the [[FastFlesh medpac/Legends|FastFlesh medpac]].<ref name="EGWT" />

They were behind the [[Chiewab Amalgamated Pharmaceuticals Company]] and [[Athakam Medtech/Legends|Athakam Medtech]] in terms of total sales volume. An [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] raid, led by [[Marl Semtin/Legends|Marl Semtin]], was conducted on the company's [[Ambria/Legends|Ambria]] sub-branch, in an effort to steal [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].
